name: docs-wiki
description: Conventions, templates and read-only audits for a project wiki: GitHub Wiki sibling repos, in-repo wiki/ folders, GitLab, Azure DevOps and MkDocs. Flat-namespace and link rules, page templates, Mermaid and PlantUML swimlane authoring with a preview-first publish pipeline, link and collision audits, and code-vs-wiki drift reports that never pick a side. One write policy: publish only on request, no history rewrites, per-target deletes. No hooks.
